title: Zesty Ethiopian Lemongrass Berbere Stew
description: A flavorful, refreshing stew that combines the bold flavors of Ethiopia with the brightness of lemongrass. Perfect for a quick and energizing dinner or lunch.

ingredients.name: berbere spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most international grocery stores or online

ingredients.name: toasted bread
ingredients.notes: french baguette or other rustic bread works well

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a molcajete over medium heat.
Add the lemongrass stalks and saut400n until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the berbere spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tomatoes, broth, and toasted bread, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the bread is fully broken down.
Stir in the ginger, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional lemongrass if desired.
This stew is best served immediately, but can be refrigerated for up to 3 days or frozen for up to 2 months.
When reheating, add a splash of water or broth if the stew has thickened too much.
Use a blender or immersion blender to puree some or all of the stew for a creamy texture.
Experiment with different spices and herbs to make this stew your own!
